conviction_note: Nothing unpriced and decisive turned up: the Century deal (signed 2026-09-16, approvals and shareholder vote announced 2026-10-09, close ~2026-11-01) is fully public and the stock sits at the deal's 10-day reference price; what is left is a GAAP-EPS risk from Q3 merger/IT costs against a disputed $1.00-$1.08 bar, offset by a Sept 16 Fed hike on an asset-sensitive book and better fee income from guided fundings/paydowns. The findings net to 0.0 and p_up 49 on abs 3.0 gives -0.06; the two numbers agree that this is close to a non-result.
bar: Disputed: Q3 2026 diluted EPS consensus $1.00 (two analysts, per the sweep row, no URL) against $1.08 at one aggregator (https://www.tickflow.io/stock/BSVN/forecast, via search snippet). Company guide is Q3 noninterest expense $9.5-9.7m and core NIM 4.45-4.53% (https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/07/23/bank7-bsvn-q2-2026-earnings-call-transcript/). The EPS bar cannot be sourced to two agreeing estimates, so every finding is capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest about 74.4K shares at the FINRA 2026-06-30 settlement, 2.86 days to cover, borrow fee 0.5% (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/bsvn/, updated 2026-07-14); an undated Equibles snapshot gives 0.76% of float and 1.7 days (https://equibles.com/stocks/BSVN). This is not a crowded short. There is no options market (baseline options.status no_options_market), so there is no skew. Spot is $55.02, 4.2% below the 52-week high, with 20-day run-up +1.2% and realised vol 13.2%.

findings.finding: The FOMC raised the funds target 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on 2026-09-16, and Bank7's CFO said on the Q2 call that the bank is asset sensitive and would benefit from a rate hike. Q3 gets about two weeks of it, so the effect shows up mainly in the Q4 NIM commentary given on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no isolated NIM-guide surprise in the baseline. The Q1 2026 print, a strong NII quarter with EPS $1.25, went +2.40%.
findings.why_not_priced: Asset sensitivity is known and the hike is public. The core NIM guide of 4.45-4.53% was set in July, before the hike. If the market had priced an upward NIM revision, the stock would be above its 52-week high instead of 4% below it. Rising rates also pressure bank multiples generally, which is why this is small.
findings.independence: The company's own statement of asset sensitivity is a different source: https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/07/23/bank7-bsvn-q2-2026-earnings-call-transcript/ (2026-07-16 call). The rest is macro-to-company transmission, and its size is a proxy.

findings.finding: Q3 carries the Century transaction's heaviest cost quarter: a contested court auction won on 2026-09-03 at $89m net, then a signed $137.3m whole-company merger on 2026-09-16 with bank, legal and receivership process. Management guided Q3 expense to $9.5-9.7m but said M&A costs were 'harder to ballpark' and that IT and consulting would be similar to Q2, when expense was $11.9m. That points to GAAP EPS at or below a $1.00 bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 had the same kind of noise (IT remediation, M&A consulting, an energy-asset item). EPS of $0.87 against $1.04 traded -2.51% on 2026-07-16 (baseline), so this name has not fully looked through cost noise.
findings.why_not_priced: Two-analyst coverage. It is unclear whether the $1.00/$1.08 estimates carry the deal costs; the higher $1.08 figure suggests at least one does not. If the market expected a cost-heavy GAAP quarter, the stock would not sit 4% off its high going into the print. It is non-recurring and sits inside a deal the market applauded, so it is sized at a fraction of the same dollars as core earnings.
findings.independence: The expense guide and the 'harder to ballpark' remark come from a different document: https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/07/23/bank7-bsvn-q2-2026-earnings-call-transcript/. The auction price is from https://www.americanbanker.com/news/after-owner-couldnt-repay-debts-nm-bank-poised-for-sale (2026-09-04).

findings.finding: Every condition except the close is cleared: Century shareholders approved on 2026-10-09, and the Federal Reserve and New Mexico FID have approved. The merger is expected to close on or about 2026-11-01, so the Q3 call is the first where management can speak to the combined company. The deck claims 25%+ 2027E EPS accretion, ~11% TBV dilution and a 1.7-year earnback.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior merger-guidance print in the baseline. The stock's 10-day average was $54.57 at signing and spot is $55.02, so the announcement was absorbed roughly flat.
findings.why_not_priced: Approvals are public and largely priced. What is not public is a combined NIM, cost-save or purchase-accounting outlook, which the deck does not quantify (no cost-save dollars, no merger-charge amount). A firm pro forma number on the call is the only new element, and its sign is uncertain, hence the wide band.
findings.independence: Same deal, different document for the accretion figures: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001746129/000114036126036855/ef20081983_ex99-2.htm (2026-09-17). Shares the deal with finding 2 but a different line: forward accretion versus Q3 cost.

findings.finding: Management flagged 'significant loan pay downs' in H2 2026 without sizing them. WTI traded about $91-105 in September 2026, which makes energy-borrower payoffs more likely. Period-end loans could therefore fall even with fundings guided at double Q2, while payoffs accelerate fee recognition.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No isolated loan-growth surprise in the baseline. Loan-fee volatility is part of every Bank7 quarter (Q1 NII $24.2m against Q2 $21.9m, from the Q2 release).
findings.why_not_priced: Paydowns were guided but never sized; an analyst asked and got no number. A Q3 loan decline would sit inside the guided caveat, so it is largely expected. The offsetting fee income is why this is small. If the market feared shrinkage, the stock would trade well below its high.
findings.independence: Oil level: https://www.psuconnect.in/market/crude-oil-price-today-14-september-2026-wti-trades-near-102-58-amid-supply-jitters (2026-09-14). This is a proxy only, not confirmed by the company.

outside_window.finding: Century merger close expected on or about 2026-11-01, with the termination date 2026-11-30 extendable to 2027-06-30. Closing risk and first consolidated results fall after the exit window.

searched_and_found_nothing: EDGAR filing list since 2026-07-01: only deal 8-Ks (09-03, 09-10, 09-17, 10-09), the Q2 10-Q, and routine Form 4/144 activity. No 8.01 credit event and no pre-release.

Insider activity: CCO Jason Estes sold 2,477 shares at about $50-51 on 2026-08-03/04 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1746129/000174612926000062/xslF345X06/form4.xml). This is small and routine, so not filed.
Credit: no news of an energy charge-off or payoff in Q3. Management said in July that 'asset quality has never been better'.
Q3 consensus: no second agreeing source; $1.00 (sweep) against $1.08 (one aggregator).
Options/skew: there is no options market.
Peer prints: no Oklahoma/Texas peer had reported Q3 by 2026-10-14 that could serve as a read-through.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Stalking-horse bid for 71% of Century raised from $68m to $89m net at the 2026-09-03 auction
rejected_candidates.detail: Superseded by the whole-company merger agreement of 2026-09-16 and merged into findings 2 and 3.

baseline_tension: No skew to agree or disagree with. Flat run-up (+1.2% over 20 days) and spot near the deal's signing reference price say the deal is digested, which fits a near-zero net.
lessons_applied: Rule 2 (size one-offs as one-offs): Q3 merger/IT cost finding cut from -0.4 to -0.3, since it is non-recurring cost inside a deal the market has absorbed; kept negative because Q2's cost-driven miss traded -2.51%.
Rule 6 (bar unsourced/disputed): $1.00 against $1.08 cannot be reconciled, so all findings stay capped small and p_up moved from 48 to 49.
Rule 5 (macro transmission small but filed): Fed-hike and oil/paydown findings kept, sized as proxies; nothing else changed.
